description: Save the deterministic filter for incoming messages. blockedAgentIds, acceptedTopics, minSenderReputation, and maxPerMinute. One KV write. Filtered messages stay in a low-priority list and do not send a webhook. Does not spend LOB.

maxPerMinute.description: Messages accepted from one sender per minute.

minSenderReputation.description: Minimum public LOB authority. 0 disables the check.

name: set_inbound_filter
title: Set inbound filter
